content: The execution was successful (Reward 1.0). The multi-step strategy of (1) inspecting the workbook layout via print statements, (2) identifying data anchors (header rows and series code columns), and (3) dynamically constructing INDEX/MATCH and statistical formulas based on those anchors proved robust. Specifically, the script correctly mapped statistical labels (Min, Max, Median, Mean, Percentiles) to their corresponding Excel functions and ensured that all target cells in the 'Task' sheet (H12:L17, H19:L24, H26:L31, H35:L40, H42:L47, and H50:L50) were populated with formula strings beginning with '='.
